# gitlab-api-lite

> Minimal GitLab REST v4 client over an injected transport: offset and keyset pagination, encoded project paths, RateLimit and Retry-After handling and same-origin next links Python package `trysac-gitlab-api-lite`, import name `gitlab_api_lite`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
